name: myportfolio3.0

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r *.html *.css *.js _headers dist/ && cp -r pages dist/ && cp -r blog dist/ && cp -r assets dist/ && cp -r utils dist/ && cp -r functions dist/
scripts.deploy: npm run build && source .env && npx wrangler pages deploy ./dist

description: A modern, responsive personal portfolio website showcasing professional skills, projects, and photography with a clean dark-themed design. Built with Node.js, Express, and Cloudflare's edge computing platform.
